title: Mira Iyer：美国市场领涨格局生变？科技七巨头短期仍强
speaker: Mira Iyer

segments.en: This is an interesting question. So again, I would put it into two phases. The next few months, I think it continues as is.
segments.zh: 这个问题很有意思。我分两个阶段看：未来几个月，我认为格局不变。

segments.en: The MAX7 are going to report great earnings. The hyperscalers are going to continue to re-emphasize their commitment to AI cat-packs, which should be good for the semiconductors, and the cell of the we've seen may even abate in the semiconductors for the next month or two.
segments.zh: 科技七巨头将交出亮眼财报，云巨头会重申AI资本开支承诺，利好半导体板块，未来一两个月半导体领域的抛压可能减弱。

segments.en: Because there will be a reconformation of the free cash flow coming their way. But a few months out, that's where I think challenges start to emerge.
segments.zh: 因为自由现金流将得到确认。但几个月后，挑战可能开始显现。
